svg.title: From PTP bytes to PtpV2Message
svg.desc: The 44-byte PTPv2 Sync message of frame 25 of ptpv2.pcap, 32 bits per row: the 34-byte common header, majorSdoId 1 and messageType 0 in the first byte, versionPTP 2 in the second, messageLength 44, domain 0, flags 0, correctionField 0, clockIdentity 00:80:63:ff:ff:00:09:ba, portNumber 1, sequenceId 115, controlField 0, logMessageInterval 0; then the Sync body, an originTimestamp of 1169232217 seconds and 174421797 nanoseconds. PtpV2Message holds the header, the body Sync, an empty TLV area and no trailing byte.
